newsitem.title: DUBAI: Bahrain oil refinery maintenance planned for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain oil refinery maintenance planned for 1997.

text.p: A vacuum unit at the 250,000 barrels per day (bpd) nameplant capacity Sitra refinery in Bahrain is expected to be shutdown in April followed by a crude distillation unit in June, industry sources said Wednesday.
The work in June would cut crude runs at the plant though product supplies to the market in both months were unlikely to be cut significantly, the sources said.
Exports from Sitra, operated by Bahrain Petroleum Company (BAPCO), run at some 230,000 bpd mainly in the form of middle distillates mainly to Asia.
The plant refines mainly Saudi Arabian crude in addition to some 40,000 bpd of domestic crude output.
Two crude units were shut at the plant in October and November to allow scheduled maintenance work.
